The '''Golden Spur''' is a [[Trinkets|trinket]] item obtainable after claiming [[Mastery Cave#Masteries|Combat Mastery]]. It can be obtained by slaying [[monsters]] or breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]] in [[the Mines]], [[Skull Cavern]], or [[Quarry Mine]]. Drop chances from both methods are affected by [[Luck#Daily Luck|daily luck]] and [[Luck#Luck Buffs|luck buffs]], among other factors. The [[Burglar's Ring]] and [[Monster Compendium]] do not impact the chance to obtain it from monsters.<ref name="tryspawntrinket" /> There is also a ≈0.6% chance to obtain a Golden Spur from a [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure chest]] in the [[Skull Cavern]].<ref name="treasureroom" />

While the Golden Spur is equipped in the trinket slot, the player gains a brief {{Name|Speed|+1|class=inline}} buff each time they land a [[Crit. Power|critical strike]]. The duration of the speed boost ranges from 5 to 10 seconds, and this time is determined to the second. Each of the six possible values is equally likely when it is dropped, and the duration can be changed if the trinket is re-forged on an [[Anvil]].<ref name="IridiumSpurStats"/>
